decision: GO for desired-state implementation and PR review; NO-GO for production activation until explicit prod context and dedicated LC Kata capacity are proven

perspectives.summary: Implement substrate, controller policy, direct charts/descriptor, then conflict-free cutover in dependency order.
deployment-controller permits one profile destination per repository/environment, so active prod delivery must converge on codicarium-prod.
kata-clh must select dedicated LC nodes; proxy, lobby, and generated servers must retain restricted security and provenance controls.
Require strict renders, negative admission tests, activation proof, rollback rehearsal, explicit prod context, and player-path smoke evidence.

external_gates: Provision and prove a dedicated Kata-capable LC node pool in codicarium-prod.
Provide a kubeconfig containing an explicitly named codicarium-prod context; the current file exposes only default.
Merge and verify dependency PRs before controller activation; never overlap legacy and controller writers.
